reviews.title: Free to download, pay to use
reviews.text: Your profile is free to make, and you’re free to swipe through people though it is limited. But you only get two free times to view your friend requests. After those two views you have to pay to see any of your other friend requests. You also can’t chat with anyone unless you pay. Advertising as free, then making it impossible to use unless buying a subscription seems a bit predatory.

reviews.title: Good app
reviews.text: Alyke is a good app for meeting new people, but I really wish it had a location-based search or filter. Overall, I like the app—this feature would make it even better!

reviews.title: Sucks
reviews.text:
It seemed cool at first but after a “trial period” the app is unusable unless you pay to make friends. Rather than having premium paid for features, you can’t do anything at all anymore and in most cases if you’ve started to make friends, it capitalizes on you essentially ghosting people because you’re no longer able to even read responses without paying for the app subscription. 

This is a horrible business model. There should be a free edition to this app but instead they’ve chosen to be selfish and make the whole thing paid for. They’re gonna lose tons of users if they continue to run the app like this.

I highly recommend that people DO NOT waste their time even installing unless you intend on paying $17.99 a month (taxes not included) just to make friends.
